claims.text: There is a scarcity of suitable educational materials on aspects of algorithmic fairness.
Educational materials on FATE can be delivered through graduate seminar courses, summer schools, embedded software engineering lectures, and high school teacher workshops.

evidence.description: The authors surveyed existing materials and past experiences in FATE education, noting the scarcity of suitable material on fairness in particular.

The authors reported on initial steps taken within an academic graduate seminar course, a graduate summer school, an embedded lecture in a software engineering course, and a workshop for high school teachers.

methodologies.name: Literature Survey and Case Study Illustration
methodologies.description: Surveyed existing FATE educational materials and used a college admission platform as an illustrative example.

limitations.text: Existing educational materials specifically covering aspects of algorithmic fairness are scarce.

future_work.text: Develop further educational resources and methodologies for educating software and AI stakeholders about algorithmic FATE.
